修复TopkV2算子多核模板偶现精度问题

Co-authored-by: caoyan_huawei<caoyan11@huawei.com>



# message auto-generated for no-merge-commit merge:
!6831 merge cy_9.1.0_topk_ouxian into 9.1.0

修复TopkV2算子多核模板偶现精度问题

Created-by: caoyan_huawei
Commit-by: caoyan_huawei
Merged-by: cann-robot
Description: ## 描述
变更摘要
本 PR 针对 TopkV2 算子多核模板偶现的精度问题，主要修改了 math/sort_with_index/op_kernel/arch35/radix_sort_with_index_multi_block.h 中基数排序后 scatter 阶段的取值来源：不再使用未排序的 8bit 中间缓冲 inputX8BitValue 做二次查表确定数据落位，而是直接使用 AscendC::Sort 输出的“8bit 排序结果”缓冲，并配套调整了该缓冲的入队/出队生命周期与流水同步，避免多核场景下写出位置与索引不一致导致的偶现精度偏差。同一改动路径下的 math/top_k_v2/op_kernel/arch35/radix_sort_top_k.h 也同步调整（该文件未提供具体补丁内容，仅有统计信息）。

主要改动

1. 全局落位计算改用排序后的 8bit 值: CopyOutGmWithIndex 中数据最终全局位置由原 blockDataInGlobalPosAddr[inputX8BitValueAddr[localDataIndex]] + i 改为 blockDataInGlobalPosAddr[sortedValueLocalAddr[i]] + i，去掉对未排序 8bit 缓冲的二次索引，直接按排序后位置取值，是本次精度修复的核心。
2. ScatterKeysGlobal 接口参数语义调整: 函数参数 LocalTensor<uint8_t> inputX8BitValue 替换为 LocalTensor<uint8_t> sortedValueLocal，CopyOutGmWithIndex 对应参数 inputX8BitValueAddr 改为 sortedValueLocalAddr，使上层传入的 8bit 数据与排序结果保持一致。
3. 排序结果缓冲的生命周期调整: AscendC::Sort 输出的 sortedValueLocal 由原来的立即 FreeTensor 改为通过 outValueQueue_ 入队、在 scatter 前 DeQue、循环末尾释放，inputX8Ub 则提前释放，保证排序结果在 scatter 阶段仍然有效。
4. 增加 V 到 S 的流水同步: 在 ScatterKeysGlobal 调用后新增 GetTPipePtr()->FetchEventID(HardEvent::V_S) 与 SetFlag/WaitFlag<HardEvent::V_S>，确保向量计算完成后再进行标量/内存相关操作。
5. 格式与注释整理: 统一了函数声明换行、指针与引用符号风格、注释对齐，并将文件末尾命名空间结束注释修正为 namespace SortWithIndex，不影响业务逻辑。

+/**
+ * Copyright (c) 2026 Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd.
+ * This program is free software, you can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms and conditions of
+ * CANN Open Software License Agreement Version 2.0 (the "License").
+ * Please refer to the License for details. You may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
+ * THIS SOFTWARE IS PROVIDED ON AN "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT WARRANTIES OF ANY KIND, EITHER EXPRESS OR IMPLIED,
+ * INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO NON-INFRINGEMENT, MERCHANTABILITY, OR FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
+ * See LICENSE in the root of the software repository for the full text of the License.
+ */
+
+#ifndef STATELESS_NORMAL_TILING_H
+#define STATELESS_NORMAL_TILING_H
+
+#include <cstdint>
+#include <cstring>
+
+#include "../../../../random_common/op_kernel/arch35/random_unified_tiling_data_arch35.h"
+#include "kernel_tiling/kernel_tiling.h"
+
+static inline unsigned long long __mul_i32toi64(unsigned int lhs, unsigned int rhs)
+{
+    return static_cast<unsigned long long>(lhs) * rhs;
+}
+
+#define __aicore__
+#ifdef __NPU_TILING__
+inline[aicore] void InitTilingData(const __gm__ uint8_t* tiling, RandomUnifiedSimtTilingDataStruct* constData)
+{
+    const __gm__ uint32_t* src = reinterpret_cast<const __gm__ uint32_t*>(tiling);
+    uint32_t* dst = reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(constData);
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(RandomUnifiedSimtTilingDataStruct) / sizeof(uint32_t); ++i) {
+        *(dst + i) = *(src + i);
+    }
+}
+#else
+inline void InitTilingData(uint8_t* tiling, RandomUnifiedSimtTilingDataStruct* constData)
+{
+    std::memcpy(constData, tiling, sizeof(RandomUnifiedSimtTilingDataStruct));
+}
+#endif // __NPU_TILING__
+
+#define CONVERT_TILING_DATA(tilingStruct, tilingDataPointer, tilingPointer) \
+    __ubuf__ tilingStruct* tilingDataPointer =                              \
+        reinterpret_cast<__ubuf__ tilingStruct*>(reinterpret_cast<__ubuf__ uint8_t*>(tilingPointer));
+
+#define INIT_TILING_DATA(tilingStruct, tilingDataPointer, tilingPointer) \
+    CONVERT_TILING_DATA(tilingStruct, tilingDataPointer, tilingPointer);
+
+#define GET_TILING_DATA_WITH_STRUCT(tilingStruct, tilingData, tilingArg) \
+    tilingStruct tilingData;                                             \
+    InitTilingData(tilingArg, &tilingData)
+
+#define GET_TILING_DATA(tilingData, tilingArg)    \
+    RandomUnifiedSimtTilingDataStruct tilingData; \
+    InitTilingData(tilingArg, &tilingData)
+
+#endif // STATELESS_SAMPLE_MULTINOMIAL_TILING_H
